description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training set is divided among 13 data sources, with 13 colored slices labeled by name and percentage. The slices are NQ (blue, 31.3%), FEVER (teal, 16.1%), SNLI (orange, 15.4%), VITAMINC (light cyan, 13.0%), MULTINLI (salmon/pink, 11.3%), ANLI (orange-brown, 4.6%), FACTCC (green, 2.6%), ENTFA (yellow, 1.8%), XSUMHUL (very light blue, 1.6%), SCITAIL (light green, 1.2%), PUBHEALTH (pale yellow, 0.5%), MULTIFC (light purple, 0.5%), and SCIFACT (gray, 0.1%). Percent values are printed next to each label with leader lines pointing to the corresponding slice, there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the arrangement appears to place the largest slice (NQ) on the right with other slices distributed around the circle rather than strictly ordered by size.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values. The largest data source is NQ, accounting for approximately 31.3% of the dataset, followed by FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI and MULTINLI are the next largest contributors, with 15.4% and 11.3%, respectively. Notably, VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset. Additionally, SCIFACT and PUBHEALTH are among the smallest contributors, with SCIFACT slightly exceeding PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each data source in the training set.
